emails.subject: AI and leadership development
emails.body:
Dear {{lastName}},

In companies, artificial intelligence is often introduced by individual departments, while the leadership team may not necessarily have a shared understanding of what this means for business strategy and future decisions.

At AIVaaS, we therefore developed the internal program The Business Power of AI, designed for leaders who want to better understand the business potential of artificial intelligence and their role in its implementation.

The program goes beyond classical trainings on using AI tools and focuses on strategic thinking, business opportunities, and alignment of the leadership team.

If developing such competencies is timely for your organization, I'd be interested in whether a brief conversation about the possibilities of implementing the program at {{companyName}} would be worthwhile?

Best regards,
{{signature}}

Pri AIVaaS smo zato razvili interni program The Business Power of AI, namenjen vodjem, ki želijo bolje razumeti poslovni potencial umetne inteligence in svojo vlogo pri njenem uvajanju.
